PLAN "Upper Body Strength for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper body strength within pain-free range, avoiding overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest_supported_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_pushup (hands on bench) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_face_pull (to chest, elbows low) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cable_row (neutral grip) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          triceps_pushdown (rope, elbows by side) 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          biceps_curl (dumbbell, supported) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_pushup (pain-free range) 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_trap_stretch 2m
